$comment: Source of truth for the revocation feed. Hand-edited; signed into
feed/revocations.json by scripts/sign-feed.ts, which CI runs on push.
Never edit revocations.json directly — it carries a signature over these
bytes and any manual change invalidates it.
Each entry: id, purl_pattern, reason, severity (critical|high|advisory),
refs (advisory URLs), added_at (ISO), and optionally versions ('<=1.0.16').
critical and high block an acquire; advisory is reported and does not.
Empty is the honest state: no revocation has been published yet. It is not
a claim that nothing in the ecosystem is malicious.
